name: Last.fm
author: BetterSoundCloud
description: Scrobbles what you play to your Last.fm profile, and shows it as “Scrobbling now” while it plays.

settings.label: Show what you’re playing on Last.fm
settings.help: Sends “Scrobbling now” as soon as a track starts, before it has played long enough to count.

settings.label: Read “Artist - Title” track names
settings.help: Many tracks are uploaded by a label or a fan, so the uploader isn’t the artist. This splits names like “Daft Punk - One More Time”. It can guess wrong when a title itself contains a dash.

settings.label: Your own API key
settings.help: Leave empty to use BetterSoundCloud’s. Only needed if Last.fm stops accepting the built-in one.

settings.label: Your own shared secret
settings.help: Goes with your own API key. Stored encrypted on this computer.
